title: Web push subscription and delivery
acceptance: Opt-in subscription stored per device; a reminder reaches a subscribed browser; unsubscribe works
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 3 hours agent; former 2-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history. Implemented 2026-11-12 (PR #301): Web push subscription and delivery via SQLite storage (push_subscriptions, push_vapid), VAPID key generation and ES256 JWT signing, RFC 8291 aes128gcm payload encryption in Node 24 native crypto, REST endpoints (/api/push/key, /api/push/subscribe, /api/push/unsubscribe, /api/push/status), push delivery dispatch upon reminder tick, 410 Gone pruning, and Angular PWA toggle passing AXE AA; covered in test/push.test.ts, test/pwa.browser.mjs, and test/angular.browser.mjs. Actual 0.5 h agent (stated).
